Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray of the 12-year-old patient (Figure 1) demonstrates prominent coarse reticular and cystic changes in the upper lobes consistent with advanced interstitial lung disease, whereas the 3-year-old patient's image (Figure 4) shows relatively clear upper lung fields with minimal to no visible subpleural cysts. This indicates that the subpleural lung cysts are significantly more prominent in the older patient.
